items.question: Trong câu "developers merge small changes into a shared mainline at least daily, and every merge is verified by an automated build and test run.", từ "verify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "developers merge small changes into a shared mainline at least daily, and every merge is verified by an automated build and test run.", what does "verify" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to check that it is correct
items.explanation: verify /ˈver.ɪ.faɪ/ (động từ): kiểm chứng, xác minh. "Be verified by" = được kiểm chứng bởi; mỗi lần merge đều được build và test tự động kiểm tra.
items.explanationEn: verify /ˈver.ɪ.faɪ/ (verb): to check that it is correct. "Be verified by" means checked by; every merge is checked by an automated build and test run.

items.question: Trong câu "Integrate often, in small batches.", từ "batch" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Integrate often, in small batches.", what does "batch" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: batch /bætʃ/ (danh từ): đợt, mẻ. "In small batches" = theo từng đợt nhỏ; mỗi lần chỉ tích hợp một ít thay đổi.
items.explanationEn: batch /bætʃ/ (noun): a group handled together. "In small batches" means a little at a time; integrate only a few changes at once.

items.question: Trong câu "A 50-line change is easy to review and revert; a three-week branch is a merge nobody wants to own.", từ "revert" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A 50-line change is easy to review and revert; a three-week branch is a merge nobody wants to own.", what does "revert" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: revert /rɪˈvɜːt/ (động từ): hoàn tác, quay lại. "Revert a change" = hoàn tác một thay đổi, đưa code về trạng thái trước đó.
items.explanationEn: revert /rɪˈvɜːt/ (verb): to undo a change. "Revert a change" means to undo it and restore the previous state.

items.question: Trong câu "The mainline is always releasable.", từ "releasable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The mainline is always releasable.", what does "releasable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: releasable /rɪˈliː.sə.bəl/ (tính từ): sẵn sàng phát hành. Hậu tố -able = có thể; "releasable" = có thể phát hành bất cứ lúc nào.
items.explanationEn: releasable /rɪˈliː.sə.bəl/ (adjective): ready to be released. The suffix -able means "can be"; releasable code can ship at any moment.

items.question: Trong câu "Aim for about 10 minutes from push to result; slower pipelines get skipped.", từ "aim" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Aim for about 10 minutes from push to result; slower pipelines get skipped.", what does "aim" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to try to reach a goal
items.explanation: aim /eɪm/ (động từ): nhắm tới, đặt mục tiêu. "Aim for X" = đặt mục tiêu đạt X; ở đây là khoảng 10 phút cho mỗi lần chạy.
items.explanationEn: aim /eɪm/ (verb): to try to reach a goal. "Aim for X" means to set X as your goal; here, about 10 minutes per run.

items.question: Trong câu "CI runs against a snapshot that drifts from everyone else's.", từ "snapshot" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CI runs against a snapshot that drifts from everyone else's.", what does "snapshot" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a state captured at one moment
items.explanation: snapshot /ˈsnæp.ʃɒt/ (danh từ): trạng thái chụp lại. "Snapshot" = trạng thái code được chụp lại tại một thời điểm và không tự cập nhật theo nhánh chính.
items.explanationEn: snapshot /ˈsnæp.ʃɒt/ (noun): a state captured at one moment. A snapshot is the code state captured at one moment; it does not follow later changes on main.

items.question: Trong câu "CI runs against a snapshot that drifts from everyone else's.", từ "drift" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CI runs against a snapshot that drifts from everyone else's.", what does "drift" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: drift /drɪft/ (động từ): dần lệch khỏi. "Drift from" = dần dần lệch xa; nhánh sống lâu ngày càng khác main.
items.explanationEn: drift /drɪft/ (verb): to slowly move away from. "Drift from" means to move away gradually; a long branch grows more and more different from main.

items.question: Trong câu "Driessen later noted that teams doing continuous delivery should prefer a simpler flow.", từ "prefer" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Driessen later noted that teams doing continuous delivery should prefer a simpler flow.", what does "prefer" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: prefer /prɪˈfɜː/ (động từ): ưu tiên chọn. "Prefer X" = chọn X hơn các lựa chọn khác; thường gặp "prefer X to Y".
items.explanationEn: prefer /prɪˈfɜː/ (verb): to choose over others. "Prefer X" means to choose X over other options; often "prefer X to Y".

items.question: Trong câu "Git mechanics are in the Git basics topic", từ "mechanics" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Git mechanics are in the Git basics topic", what does "mechanics" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: mechanics /mɪˈkæn.ɪks/ (danh từ): cách vận hành cụ thể. "The mechanics of X" = cách X hoạt động ở mức chi tiết, thao tác cụ thể.
items.explanationEn: mechanics /mɪˈkæn.ɪks/ (noun): how it works in detail. "The mechanics of X" are the practical details of how X works.

items.question: Trong câu "so two individually green PRs cannot combine into a red main.", từ "individually" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "so two individually green PRs cannot combine into a red main.", what does "individually" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: individually /ˌɪn.dɪˈvɪdʒ.u.ə.li/ (trạng từ): riêng lẻ, từng cái. "Individually green" = mỗi PR xanh khi xét riêng, nhưng gộp lại vẫn có thể làm main đỏ.
items.explanationEn: individually /ˌɪn.dɪˈvɪdʒ.u.ə.li/ (adverb): separately, one by one. "Individually green" means each PR passes on its own, yet together they can still break main.

items.question: Trong câu "Trunk-based development is what DORA research links to high performance.", từ "link" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Trunk-based development is what DORA research links to high performance.", what does "link" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: link /lɪŋk/ (động từ): liên hệ, gắn với. "Link X to Y" = cho thấy X có liên quan tới Y; nghiên cứu DORA gắn trunk-based với hiệu suất cao.
items.explanationEn: link /lɪŋk/ (verb): to connect with. "Link X to Y" means to show X is connected with Y; DORA connects trunk-based work with high performance.

items.question: Trong câu "Parallelise independent jobs (lint, unit tests, SAST) and gate build on all of them.", từ "independent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Parallelise independent jobs (lint, unit tests, SAST) and gate build on all of them.", what does "independent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: independent /ˌɪn.dɪˈpen.dənt/ (tính từ): độc lập, không phụ thuộc. "Independent jobs" = các job không cần kết quả của nhau nên chạy song song được.
items.explanationEn: independent /ˌɪn.dɪˈpen.dənt/ (adjective): not relying on another. "Independent jobs" do not need each other's results, so they can run in parallel.

items.question: Trong câu "Parallelise independent jobs (lint, unit tests, SAST) and gate build on all of them.", từ "gate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Parallelise independent jobs (lint, unit tests, SAST) and gate build on all of them.", what does "gate" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to fence off with a gate
to make depend on a check
items.explanation: gate /ɡeɪt/ (động từ): đặt điều kiện chặn. "Gate X on Y" = chỉ cho X chạy khi Y đã đạt; build chỉ chạy khi mọi job trước thành công.
items.explanationEn: gate /ɡeɪt/ (verb): to make depend on a check. "Gate X on Y" means X runs only after Y passes; build waits for all earlier jobs to succeed.

items.question: Trong câu "Gates must be binding.", từ "binding" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Gates must be binding.", what does "binding" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: binding /ˈbaɪn.dɪŋ/ (tính từ): có tính ràng buộc. "Binding" = bắt buộc tuân theo; kiểm tra thất bại phải chặn được pipeline. Ví dụ: a binding contract.
items.explanationEn: binding /ˈbaɪn.dɪŋ/ (adjective): required to be obeyed. "Binding" means it must be obeyed; a failed check must stop the pipeline. Example: a binding contract.

items.question: Trong câu "A scan that never fails is decoration", từ "decoration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A scan that never fails is decoration", what does "decoration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: decoration /ˌdek.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (danh từ): đồ trang trí, cho có. Nghĩa bóng: thứ chỉ để trưng cho đẹp, không có tác dụng thật.
items.explanationEn: decoration /ˌdek.əˈreɪ.ʃən/ (noun): something only for show. Used figuratively: something that looks nice but does no real work.

items.question: Trong câu "The inverse ice-cream cone yields 45-minute pipelines that fail randomly.", từ "inverse" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The inverse ice-cream cone yields 45-minute pipelines that fail randomly.", what does "inverse" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: inverse /ˈɪn.vɜːs/ (tính từ): ngược lại, đảo ngược. "The inverse X" = hình ngược của X; "cây kem" là tháp kiểm thử bị lộn ngược.
items.explanationEn: inverse /ˈɪn.vɜːs/ (adjective): opposite, reversed. "The inverse X" is X turned the other way; the ice-cream cone is an upside-down test pyramid.

items.question: Trong câu "The inverse ice-cream cone yields 45-minute pipelines that fail randomly.", từ "yield" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The inverse ice-cream cone yields 45-minute pipelines that fail randomly.", what does "yield" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: yield /jiːld/ (động từ): tạo ra, dẫn đến. "Yield" = sinh ra kết quả; nghĩa khác là nhường (yield to traffic).
items.explanationEn: yield /jiːld/ (verb): to produce as a result. "Yield" means to produce a result; another sense is to give way (yield to traffic).

items.question: Trong câu "The inverse ice-cream cone yields 45-minute pipelines that fail randomly.", từ "randomly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The inverse ice-cream cone yields 45-minute pipelines that fail randomly.", what does "randomly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: randomly /ˈræn.dəm.li/ (trạng từ): một cách ngẫu nhiên. "Fail randomly" = thất bại ngẫu nhiên, không theo quy luật nào.
items.explanationEn: randomly /ˈræn.dəm.li/ (adverb): without any pattern. "Fail randomly" means failing with no predictable pattern.

items.question: Trong câu "Flaky tests (pass/fail with no code change) destroy trust: people re-run instead of reading failures.", từ "flaky" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Flaky tests (pass/fail with no code change) destroy trust: people re-run instead of reading failures.", what does "flaky" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: flaky /ˈfleɪ.ki/ (tính từ): chập chờn, thất thường. "Flaky test" = test lúc pass lúc fail dù code không đổi.
items.explanationEn: flaky /ˈfleɪ.ki/ (adjective): unreliable, inconsistent. A flaky test passes or fails without any change to the code.

items.question: Trong câu "Quarantine them into a non-blocking job, then fix or delete.", từ "quarantine" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Quarantine them into a non-blocking job, then fix or delete.", what does "quarantine" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: quarantine /ˈkwɒr.ən.tiːn/ (động từ): cách ly. Gốc là cách ly (người bệnh); ở đây là tách test chập chờn sang job không chặn pipeline.
items.explanationEn: quarantine /ˈkwɒr.ən.tiːn/ (verb): to isolate. Originally to isolate the sick; here, to move flaky tests into a job that cannot block the pipeline.

items.question: Trong câu "Sharding splits a suite across parallel jobs", từ "suite" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sharding splits a suite across parallel jobs", what does "suite" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: suite /swiːt/ (danh từ): bộ (kiểm thử). "Test suite" = bộ test; lưu ý đọc /swiːt/ giống "sweet".
items.explanationEn: suite /swiːt/ (noun): a set of tests. "Test suite" means a collection of tests; note it is pronounced like "sweet".

items.question: Trong câu "Hermetic tests start their own Postgres container instead of sharing a staging DB.", từ "hermetic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Hermetic tests start their own Postgres container instead of sharing a staging DB.", what does "hermetic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: hermetic /hɜːˈmet.ɪk/ (tính từ): khép kín, tự cô lập. Gốc là "kín hơi"; test hermetic không phụ thuộc môi trường bên ngoài.
items.explanationEn: hermetic /hɜːˈmet.ɪk/ (adjective): fully self-contained. Originally "airtight"; a hermetic test depends on nothing outside itself.

items.question: Trong câu "Coverage is a signal, not a target; a floor on changed lines beats a global 100%.", từ "floor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Coverage is a signal, not a target; a floor on changed lines beats a global 100%.", what does "floor" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: floor /flɔː/ (danh từ): mức sàn tối thiểu. "A floor on X" = mức tối thiểu cho X; ngược lại là "ceiling" (mức trần).
items.explanationEn: floor /flɔː/ (noun): a minimum level. "A floor on X" is a minimum for X; the opposite is a "ceiling".

items.question: Trong câu "Coverage is a signal, not a target; a floor on changed lines beats a global 100%.", từ "coverage" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Coverage is a signal, not a target; a floor on changed lines beats a global 100%.", what does "coverage" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: coverage /ˈkʌv.ər.ɪdʒ/ (danh từ): độ bao phủ của test. "Test coverage" = tỉ lệ code được test chạy qua; không nên coi là mục tiêu tuyệt đối.
items.explanationEn: coverage /ˈkʌv.ər.ɪdʒ/ (noun): the share of code tested. "Test coverage" is the share of code executed by tests; it should not be a goal in itself.

items.question: Trong câu "A workflow is a YAML file in .github/workflows/, triggered by events.", từ "trigger" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A workflow is a YAML file in .github/workflows/, triggered by events.", what does "trigger" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: trigger /ˈtrɪɡ.ə/ (động từ): kích hoạt. "Triggered by events" = được kích hoạt bởi sự kiện như push hay mở PR.
items.explanationEn: trigger /ˈtrɪɡ.ə/ (verb): to cause to start. "Triggered by events" means started by events such as a push or a new PR.

items.question: Trong câu "It holds jobs that run on runners; each job is a list of steps — shell commands (run) or reusable actions (uses).", từ "reusable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "It holds jobs that run on runners; each job is a list of steps — shell commands (run) or reusable actions (uses).", what does "reusable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: reusable /riːˈjuː.zə.bəl/ (tính từ): tái sử dụng được. re- (lại) + use (dùng) + -able (có thể): dùng lại được nhiều lần.
items.explanationEn: reusable /riːˈjuː.zə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be used again. re- (again) + use + -able (can be): something you can use many times.

items.question: Trong câu "Jobs run in parallel by default, each on a fresh VM; needs: adds ordering.", từ "by default" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Jobs run in parallel by default, each on a fresh VM; needs: adds ordering.", what does "by default" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: by default /baɪ dɪˈfɔːlt/ (cụm từ): theo mặc định. "By default" = theo mặc định, khi không cấu hình gì khác. Danh từ "default" còn có nghĩa là vỡ nợ.
items.explanationEn: by default /baɪ dɪˈfɔːlt/ (phrase): unless set otherwise. "By default" means when nothing else is configured. The noun "default" can also mean failing to repay a debt.

items.question: Trong câu "Jobs run in parallel by default, each on a fresh VM; needs: adds ordering.", từ "fresh" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Jobs run in parallel by default, each on a fresh VM; needs: adds ordering.", what does "fresh" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: fresh /freʃ/ (tính từ): mới tinh, sạch. "A fresh VM" = máy ảo mới hoàn toàn, không còn dữ liệu từ lần chạy trước.
items.explanationEn: fresh /freʃ/ (adjective): new and clean. "A fresh VM" is a brand-new machine with nothing left from earlier runs.

items.question: Trong câu "Steps in a job share one machine and workspace.", từ "workspace" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Steps in a job share one machine and workspace.", what does "workspace" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: workspace /ˈwɜːk.speɪs/ (danh từ): thư mục làm việc. Trong CI, "workspace" = thư mục chứa code và file tạm mà các step dùng chung.
items.explanationEn: workspace /ˈwɜːk.speɪs/ (noun): a working directory. In CI, the workspace is the directory holding the code and files that steps share.

items.question: Trong câu "permissions: scopes the automatic GITHUB_TOKEN; start at contents: read.", từ "scope" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "permissions: scopes the automatic GITHUB_TOKEN; start at contents: read.", what does "scope" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: scope /skəʊp/ (động từ): giới hạn phạm vi. "Scope a token" = giới hạn những gì token được phép làm.
items.explanationEn: scope /skəʊp/ (verb): to limit the reach of. "Scope a token" means to limit what the token is allowed to do.

items.question: Trong câu "concurrency + cancel-in-progress kills superseded runs.", từ "supersede" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "concurrency + cancel-in-progress kills superseded runs.", what does "supersede" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: supersede /ˌsuː.pəˈsiːd/ (động từ): thay thế bản cũ. "Superseded run" = lần chạy cũ đã bị lần chạy mới hơn thay thế.
items.explanationEn: supersede /ˌsuː.pəˈsiːd/ (verb): to replace an older one. A superseded run is an older run replaced by a newer one.

items.question: Trong câu "timeout-minutes defaults to 360; set a realistic value.", từ "realistic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "timeout-minutes defaults to 360; set a realistic value.", what does "realistic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: realistic /ˌrɪəˈlɪs.tɪk/ (tính từ): hợp lý, sát thực tế. "A realistic value" = giá trị hợp lý với thực tế, không quá lớn như mặc định 360 phút.
items.explanationEn: realistic /ˌrɪəˈlɪs.tɪk/ (adjective): sensible and practical. "A realistic value" fits reality, unlike the huge 360-minute default.

items.question: Trong câu "Jobs belong to stages; jobs in one stage run in parallel, stages run in order, and needs: turns it into a DAG.", từ "belong to" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Jobs belong to stages; jobs in one stage run in parallel, stages run in order, and needs: turns it into a DAG.", what does "belong to" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: belong to /bɪˈlɒŋ tuː/ (cụm từ): thuộc về. "Belong to" = thuộc về; mỗi job thuộc một stage.
items.explanationEn: belong to /bɪˈlɒŋ tuː/ (phrase): to be part of. "Belong to" means to be part of; every job is part of one stage.

items.question: Trong câu "Jobs belong to stages; jobs in one stage run in parallel, stages run in order, and needs: turns it into a DAG.", từ "in order" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Jobs belong to stages; jobs in one stage run in parallel, stages run in order, and needs: turns it into a DAG.", what does "in order" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: in order /ɪn ˈɔː.də/ (cụm từ): theo thứ tự. "In order" = lần lượt theo thứ tự; khác với "in order to" = để.
items.explanationEn: in order /ɪn ˈɔː.də/ (phrase): one after another. "In order" means in sequence; do not confuse it with "in order to" (so as to).

items.question: Trong câu "Jobs belong to stages; jobs in one stage run in parallel, stages run in order, and needs: turns it into a DAG.", từ "turn into" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Jobs belong to stages; jobs in one stage run in parallel, stages run in order, and needs: turns it into a DAG.", what does "turn into" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: turn into /tɜːn ˈɪn.tuː/ (cụm từ): biến thành. "Turn X into Y" = biến X thành Y; needs: biến chuỗi stage thành đồ thị DAG.
items.explanationEn: turn into /tɜːn ˈɪn.tuː/ (phrase): to change into. "Turn X into Y" means to change X so it becomes Y; needs: changes stages into a DAG.

items.question: Trong câu "On AWS: CodeBuild (buildspec.yml) orchestrated by CodePipeline.", từ "orchestrate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "On AWS: CodeBuild (buildspec.yml) orchestrated by CodePipeline.", what does "orchestrate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: orchestrate /ˈɔː.kɪ.streɪt/ (động từ): điều phối. Gốc âm nhạc là phối khí cho dàn nhạc; trong kỹ thuật là điều phối nhiều bước/dịch vụ.
items.explanationEn: orchestrate /ˈɔː.kɪ.streɪt/ (verb): to coordinate steps. In music it means to arrange for an orchestra; in tech it means to coordinate several steps or services.

items.question: Trong câu "Downstream jobs break", từ "downstream" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Downstream jobs break", what does "downstream" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: downstream /ˌdaʊnˈstriːm/ (tính từ): phía sau trong chuỗi. "Downstream jobs" = các job chạy sau và dùng output của job trước; ngược lại là "upstream".
items.explanationEn: downstream /ˌdaʊnˈstriːm/ (adjective): later in the chain. Downstream jobs run later and use earlier output; the opposite is "upstream".

items.question: Trong câu "Key on the lockfile hash; restore-keys gives a partial hit to start from.", từ "partial" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Key on the lockfile hash; restore-keys gives a partial hit to start from.", what does "partial" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: partial /ˈpɑː.ʃəl/ (tính từ): một phần. "A partial hit" = khớp một phần cache; "partial to" còn có nghĩa là thiên vị, thích.
items.explanationEn: partial /ˈpɑː.ʃəl/ (adjective): not complete. "A partial hit" matches only part of the cache; "partial to" can also mean fond of or biased.

items.question: Trong câu "Cache poisoning: GitHub scopes caches by branch — a PR can read main's cache but not write to it.", từ "poisoning" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cache poisoning: GitHub scopes caches by branch — a PR can read main's cache but not write to it.", what does "poisoning" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: poisoning /ˈpɔɪ.zən.ɪŋ/ (danh từ): làm nhiễm bẩn dữ liệu. "Cache poisoning" = kẻ tấn công đưa dữ liệu độc vào cache để lần chạy sau dùng phải.
items.explanationEn: poisoning /ˈpɔɪ.zən.ɪŋ/ (noun): tainting with bad data. Cache poisoning means an attacker plants bad data in a cache so later runs use it.

items.question: Trong câu "That yields 3 jobs (2 × 2 minus one).", từ "minus" (giới từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That yields 3 jobs (2 × 2 minus one).", what does "minus" (preposition) mean?
items.explanation: minus /ˈmaɪ.nəs/ (giới từ): trừ đi. "2 × 2 minus one" = 2 nhân 2 trừ 1 = 3 job.
items.explanationEn: minus /ˈmaɪ.nəs/ (preposition): subtracting. "2 × 2 minus one" means two times two, take away one: three jobs.

items.question: Trong câu "A matrix can generate at most 256 jobs per workflow run.", từ "at most" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A matrix can generate at most 256 jobs per workflow run.", what does "at most" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: at most /ət məʊst/ (cụm từ): tối đa, nhiều nhất. "At most N" = nhiều nhất là N; ngược lại là "at least N".
items.explanationEn: at most /ət məʊst/ (phrase): no more than. "At most N" means no more than N; the opposite is "at least N".

items.question: Trong câu "A matrix can generate at most 256 jobs per workflow run.", từ "generate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A matrix can generate at most 256 jobs per workflow run.", what does "generate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: generate /ˈdʒen.ə.reɪt/ (động từ): tạo ra, sinh ra. "Generate jobs" = sinh ra các job từ tổ hợp giá trị của matrix.
items.explanationEn: generate /ˈdʒen.ə.reɪt/ (verb): to create or produce. "Generate jobs" means to produce jobs from every combination of matrix values.

items.question: Trong câu "fail-fast defaults to true (one failure cancels the rest); max-parallel caps concurrency.", từ "cap" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "fail-fast defaults to true (one failure cancels the rest); max-parallel caps concurrency.", what does "cap" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to set an upper limit on
items.explanation: cap /kæp/ (động từ): đặt mức trần. "Cap X" = giới hạn X ở mức tối đa; danh từ "cap" còn là mũ lưỡi trai hoặc nắp.
items.explanationEn: cap /kæp/ (verb): to set an upper limit on. "Cap X" means to set a maximum for X; the noun "cap" is also a hat or a lid.

items.question: Trong câu "Matrices suit libraries supporting several runtimes; an app deployed on one runtime needs one.", từ "suit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Matrices suit libraries supporting several runtimes; an app deployed on one runtime needs one.", what does "suit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: suit /suːt/ (động từ): phù hợp với. "X suits Y" = X phù hợp với Y; danh từ "suit" là bộ com-lê.
items.explanationEn: suit /suːt/ (verb): to be right for. "X suits Y" means X is a good fit for Y; the noun "suit" is a set of formal clothes.

items.question: Trong câu "a required check that never runs blocks merges", từ "block" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "a required check that never runs blocks merges", what does "block" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: block /blɒk/ (động từ): chặn, ngăn lại. "Block merges" = chặn không cho merge; check bắt buộc mà không chạy sẽ treo PR mãi.
items.explanationEn: block /blɒk/ (verb): to stop from happening. "Block merges" means to stop merging; a required check that never runs leaves the PR stuck.

items.question: Trong câu "Affected-graph tools (Nx, Turborepo, Bazel) run only projects a change touches, with remote caching.", từ "remote" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Affected-graph tools (Nx, Turborepo, Bazel) run only projects a change touches, with remote caching.", what does "remote" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: remote /rɪˈməʊt/ (tính từ): từ xa, qua mạng. "Remote caching" = cache lưu trên máy chủ từ xa, dùng chung cho nhiều máy.
items.explanationEn: remote /rɪˈməʊt/ (adjective): accessed over a network. "Remote caching" stores the cache on a server so many machines can share it.

items.question: Trong câu "CI can push to your registry and often reach production — a prime target.", từ "prime" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CI can push to your registry and often reach production — a prime target.", what does "prime" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: prime /praɪm/ (tính từ): hàng đầu, chính yếu. "A prime target" = mục tiêu hàng đầu; "prime number" = số nguyên tố.
items.explanationEn: prime /praɪm/ (adjective): main, most likely. "A prime target" is the most obvious target; a "prime number" is a different sense.

items.question: Trong câu "Log masking is best-effort (base64 defeats it).", từ "best-effort" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Log masking is best-effort (base64 defeats it).", what does "best-effort" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: best-effort /ˌbest ˈef.ət/ (tính từ): không được đảm bảo. "Best-effort" = cố gắng hết sức nhưng không cam kết luôn thành công.
items.explanationEn: best-effort /ˌbest ˈef.ət/ (adjective): not guaranteed. "Best-effort" means it tries its best but promises nothing.

items.question: Trong câu "Log masking is best-effort (base64 defeats it).", từ "defeat" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Log masking is best-effort (base64 defeats it).", what does "defeat" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: defeat /dɪˈfiːt/ (động từ): vô hiệu hóa, qua mặt. "Base64 defeats it" = mã hóa base64 khiến cơ chế che log mất tác dụng.
items.explanationEn: defeat /dɪˈfiːt/ (verb): to make ineffective. "Base64 defeats it" means base64 encoding makes the masking useless.

items.question: Trong câu "Least privilege: default permissions: contents: read; in GitLab, protected variables exist only on protected branches/tags.", từ "privilege" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Least privilege: default permissions: contents: read; in GitLab, protected variables exist only on protected branches/tags.", what does "privilege" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: privilege /ˈprɪv.əl.ɪdʒ/ (danh từ): quyền hạn truy cập. "Least privilege" = chỉ cấp quyền tối thiểu cần thiết.
items.explanationEn: privilege /ˈprɪv.əl.ɪdʒ/ (noun): an access right. "Least privilege" means granting only the minimum access needed.

items.question: Trong câu "the job gets a short-lived signed token, the cloud trusts it for one repo/branch and returns temporary credentials.", từ "short-lived" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the job gets a short-lived signed token, the cloud trusts it for one repo/branch and returns temporary credentials.", what does "short-lived" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: short-lived /ˌʃɔːtˈlɪvd/ (tính từ): tồn tại ngắn. "Short-lived token" = token hết hạn nhanh; trái nghĩa là "long-lived".
items.explanationEn: short-lived /ˌʃɔːtˈlɪvd/ (adjective): lasting a short time. A short-lived token expires quickly; the opposite is "long-lived".

items.question: Trong câu "the job gets a short-lived signed token, the cloud trusts it for one repo/branch and returns temporary credentials.", từ "credential" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "the job gets a short-lived signed token, the cloud trusts it for one repo/branch and returns temporary credentials.", what does "credential" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: credential /krəˈden.ʃəl/ (danh từ): thông tin xác thực. "Credentials" thường ở số nhiều: khóa/mật khẩu dùng để xác thực. Nghĩa khác: bằng cấp.
items.explanationEn: credential /krəˈden.ʃəl/ (noun): login or access keys. "Credentials" is usually plural: keys or passwords used to authenticate. Another sense: qualifications.

items.question: Trong câu "The trust policy must constrain sub; otherwise any GitHub repository can assume the role.", từ "constrain" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The trust policy must constrain sub; otherwise any GitHub repository can assume the role.", what does "constrain" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: constrain /kənˈstreɪn/ (động từ): ràng buộc, giới hạn. "Constrain sub" = giới hạn trường sub để chỉ repo/nhánh cụ thể được dùng role.
items.explanationEn: constrain /kənˈstreɪn/ (verb): to restrict. "Constrain sub" means to restrict the sub claim so only one repo or branch can use the role.

items.question: Trong câu "The trust policy must constrain sub; otherwise any GitHub repository can assume the role.", từ "otherwise" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The trust policy must constrain sub; otherwise any GitHub repository can assume the role.", what does "otherwise" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: otherwise /ˈʌð.ə.waɪz/ (trạng từ): nếu không thì. "Otherwise" = nếu không làm vậy thì; dùng để nêu hậu quả.
items.explanationEn: otherwise /ˈʌð.ə.waɪz/ (adverb): if not, then. "Otherwise" means if that is not done; it introduces the consequence.

items.question: Trong câu "The trust policy must constrain sub; otherwise any GitHub repository can assume the role.", từ "assume" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The trust policy must constrain sub; otherwise any GitHub repository can assume the role.", what does "assume" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (động từ): đảm nhận (vai trò). "Assume a role" = nhận quyền của một role; nghĩa thường gặp khác là giả định.
items.explanationEn: assume /əˈsjuːm/ (verb): to take on a role. "Assume a role" means to take on its permissions; the everyday sense is to suppose.

items.question: Trong câu "app:1.4.2 is never overwritten; enable registry tag immutability (ECR supports it) and deploy by digest (app@sha256:…), which cannot move.", từ "overwrite" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "app:1.4.2 is never overwritten; enable registry tag immutability (ECR supports it) and deploy by digest (app@sha256:…), which cannot move.", what does "overwrite" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: overwrite /ˌəʊ.vəˈraɪt/ (động từ): ghi đè. "Never overwritten" = không bao giờ bị ghi đè; tag đã đẩy thì giữ nguyên nội dung.
items.explanationEn: overwrite /ˌəʊ.vəˈraɪt/ (verb): to replace existing data. "Never overwritten" means the existing content is never replaced; a pushed tag stays the same.

items.question: Trong câu "app:1.4.2 is never overwritten; enable registry tag immutability (ECR supports it) and deploy by digest (app@sha256:…), which cannot move.", từ "immutability" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "app:1.4.2 is never overwritten; enable registry tag immutability (ECR supports it) and deploy by digest (app@sha256:…), which cannot move.", what does "immutability" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: immutability /ɪˌmjuː.təˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (danh từ): tính bất biến. "Tag immutability" = tag không thể bị gán lại cho image khác. Tính từ: immutable.
items.explanationEn: immutability /ɪˌmjuː.təˈbɪl.ə.ti/ (noun): being unchangeable. "Tag immutability" means a tag cannot be moved to another image. Adjective: immutable.

items.question: Trong câu "app:1.4.2 is never overwritten; enable registry tag immutability (ECR supports it) and deploy by digest (app@sha256:…), which cannot move.", từ "digest" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "app:1.4.2 is never overwritten; enable registry tag immutability (ECR supports it) and deploy by digest (app@sha256:…), which cannot move.", what does "digest" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: digest /ˈdaɪ.dʒest/ (danh từ): mã băm nội dung. "Deploy by digest" = deploy theo mã băm sha256 của image; nghĩa khác là bản tóm tắt.
items.explanationEn: digest /ˈdaɪ.dʒest/ (noun): a content hash. "Deploy by digest" means deploying by the image's sha256 hash; another sense is a summary.

items.question: Trong câu "Embed metadata: OCI label org.opencontainers.image.revision and a /version endpoint.", từ "embed" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Embed metadata: OCI label org.opencontainers.image.revision and a /version endpoint.", what does "embed" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: embed /ɪmˈbed/ (động từ): nhúng vào. "Embed X in Y" = nhúng X vào bên trong Y; ở đây là gắn thông tin phiên bản vào image.
items.explanationEn: embed /ɪmˈbed/ (verb): to put inside. "Embed X in Y" means to place X inside Y; here, version details go into the image.

items.question: Trong câu "In March 2025 the tj-actions/changed-files action had its version tags repointed to a malicious commit that dumped CI secrets into logs; every workflow using it by tag ran the payload.", từ "malicious" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In March 2025 the tj-actions/changed-files action had its version tags repointed to a malicious commit that dumped CI secrets into logs; every workflow using it by tag ran the payload.", what does "malicious" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: malicious /məˈlɪʃ.əs/ (tính từ): độc hại, có ác ý. "Malicious commit" = commit chứa mã độc có chủ đích; "malware" cũng từ gốc "mal-" (xấu).
items.explanationEn: malicious /məˈlɪʃ.əs/ (adjective): meant to do harm. A malicious commit contains code meant to harm; "malware" shares the "mal-" (bad) root.

items.question: Trong câu "In March 2025 the tj-actions/changed-files action had its version tags repointed to a malicious commit that dumped CI secrets into logs; every workflow using it by tag ran the payload.", từ "dump" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In March 2025 the tj-actions/changed-files action had its version tags repointed to a malicious commit that dumped CI secrets into logs; every workflow using it by tag ran the payload.", what does "dump" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: dump /dʌmp/ (động từ): đổ ra, xuất ra. "Dump secrets into logs" = xuất toàn bộ secret ra log; "memory dump" = bản xuất bộ nhớ.
items.explanationEn: dump /dʌmp/ (verb): to output all of. "Dump secrets into logs" means to print them all out; a "memory dump" is a similar idea.

items.question: Trong câu "In March 2025 the tj-actions/changed-files action had its version tags repointed to a malicious commit that dumped CI secrets into logs; every workflow using it by tag ran the payload.", từ "payload" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In March 2025 the tj-actions/changed-files action had its version tags repointed to a malicious commit that dumped CI secrets into logs; every workflow using it by tag ran the payload.", what does "payload" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: payload /ˈpeɪ.ləʊd/ (danh từ): phần mã độc thực thi. Trong bảo mật, "payload" = phần mã gây hại được thực thi; nghĩa gốc là tải trọng hàng hóa.
items.explanationEn: payload /ˈpeɪ.ləʊd/ (noun): the harmful code delivered. In security, the payload is the harmful code that runs; originally it meant cargo.

items.question: Trong câu "npm ci fails if lockfile and package.json disagree.", từ "disagree" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "npm ci fails if lockfile and package.json disagree.", what does "disagree" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: disagree /ˌdɪs.əˈɡriː/ (động từ): không khớp nhau. Với dữ liệu, "disagree" = hai nguồn không khớp nhau.
items.explanationEn: disagree /ˌdɪs.əˈɡriː/ (verb): to not match. Applied to data, "disagree" means two sources do not match.

items.question: Trong câu "Tags move, SHAs do not; Dependabot/Renovate bump the pins.", từ "bump" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Tags move, SHAs do not; Dependabot/Renovate bump the pins.", what does "bump" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: bump /bʌmp/ (động từ): nâng phiên bản. "Bump a version" = nâng số phiên bản lên; nghĩa gốc là va chạm nhẹ.
items.explanationEn: bump /bʌmp/ (verb): to raise a version. "Bump a version" means to increase it; the basic sense is to knock into something.

items.question: Trong câu "Pin base images by digest for reproducible builds.", từ "reproducible" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Pin base images by digest for reproducible builds.", what does "reproducible" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: reproducible /ˌriː.prəˈdjuː.sə.bəl/ (tính từ): tái tạo y hệt được. "Reproducible build" = build lại nhiều lần vẫn ra kết quả giống hệt.
items.explanationEn: reproducible /ˌriː.prəˈdjuː.sə.bəl/ (adjective): able to be repeated exactly. A reproducible build gives exactly the same result every time.

items.question: Trong câu "SLSA grades how tamper-resistant the build is.", từ "grade" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "SLSA grades how tamper-resistant the build is.", what does "grade" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: grade /ɡreɪd/ (động từ): đánh giá theo cấp. "Grade X" = chấm/xếp X theo cấp độ; SLSA chia mức độ an toàn của build.
items.explanationEn: grade /ɡreɪd/ (verb): to rate by level. "Grade X" means to rate X by level; SLSA defines levels of build security.

items.question: Trong câu "SLSA grades how tamper-resistant the build is.", từ "tamper-resistant" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "SLSA grades how tamper-resistant the build is.", what does "tamper-resistant" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: tamper-resistant /ˈtæm.pə rɪˌzɪs.tənt/ (tính từ): chống can thiệp lén. "Tamper" = can thiệp, sửa trái phép; "tamper-resistant" = khó bị sửa lén.
items.explanationEn: tamper-resistant /ˈtæm.pə rɪˌzɪs.tənt/ (adjective): hard to alter secretly. "Tamper" means to interfere without permission; tamper-resistant means hard to alter secretly.

items.question: Trong câu "Sign and attest: Sigstore cosign (keyless via OIDC), build provenance, signature verification at deploy.", từ "provenance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sign and attest: Sigstore cosign (keyless via OIDC), build provenance, signature verification at deploy.", what does "provenance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: provenance /ˈprɒv.ən.əns/ (danh từ): nguồn gốc xuất xứ. "Build provenance" = bằng chứng artifact được build từ đâu, bằng commit nào.
items.explanationEn: provenance /ˈprɒv.ən.əns/ (noun): origin and history. "Build provenance" is evidence of where and from which commit an artifact was built.

items.question: Trong câu "Self-hosted runners should be ephemeral (one job, then destroyed — e.g. Actions Runner Controller on Kubernetes) and never serve public repositories, where a fork PR could run code inside your network.", từ "ephemeral" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Self-hosted runners should be ephemeral (one job, then destroyed — e.g. Actions Runner Controller on Kubernetes) and never serve public repositories, where a fork PR could run code inside your network.", what does "ephemeral" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ephemeral /ɪˈfem.ər.əl/ (tính từ): tồn tại ngắn ngủi. "Ephemeral runner" = runner chạy một job rồi bị hủy.
items.explanationEn: ephemeral /ɪˈfem.ər.əl/ (adjective): lasting a very short time. An ephemeral runner handles one job and is then destroyed.

items.question: Trong câu "Self-hosted runners should be ephemeral (one job, then destroyed — e.g. Actions Runner Controller on Kubernetes) and never serve public repositories, where a fork PR could run code inside your network.", từ "serve" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Self-hosted runners should be ephemeral (one job, then destroyed — e.g. Actions Runner Controller on Kubernetes) and never serve public repositories, where a fork PR could run code inside your network.", what does "serve" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: serve /sɜːv/ (động từ): phục vụ cho. "Serve public repositories" = nhận và chạy job cho các repo công khai.
items.explanationEn: serve /sɜːv/ (verb): to work for. "Serve public repositories" means to accept and run jobs for public repos.

items.question: Trong câu "Review red flags: pipeline logic clicked into a CI UI instead of versioned files; rebuilding per environment; everything sequential; ignored red builds; one admin token shared by every job.", từ "red flag" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Review red flags: pipeline logic clicked into a CI UI instead of versioned files; rebuilding per environment; everything sequential; ignored red builds; one admin token shared by every job.", what does "red flag" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: red flag /ˌred ˈflæɡ/ (cụm từ): dấu hiệu cảnh báo. "Red flag" = dấu hiệu cho thấy có vấn đề cần chú ý.
items.explanationEn: red flag /ˌred ˈflæɡ/ (phrase): a warning sign. A red flag is a sign that something is wrong.

items.question: Trong câu "Review red flags: pipeline logic clicked into a CI UI instead of versioned files; rebuilding per environment; everything sequential; ignored red builds; one admin token shared by every job.", từ "sequential" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Review red flags: pipeline logic clicked into a CI UI instead of versioned files; rebuilding per environment; everything sequential; ignored red builds; one admin token shared by every job.", what does "sequential" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: sequential /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl/ (tính từ): tuần tự. "Everything sequential" = mọi job chạy nối tiếp, không song song nên rất chậm.
items.explanationEn: sequential /sɪˈkwen.ʃəl/ (adjective): one after another. "Everything sequential" means all jobs run one by one, never in parallel, so it is slow.

items.question: Trong câu "CI = small, frequent merges to mainline, each verified automatically; main stays green; ~10-minute feedback.", từ "frequent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "CI = small, frequent merges to mainline, each verified automatically; main stays green; ~10-minute feedback.", what does "frequent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: frequent /ˈfriː.kwənt/ (tính từ): thường xuyên. "Frequent merges" = merge thường xuyên; danh từ: frequency (tần suất).
items.explanationEn: frequent /ˈfriː.kwənt/ (adjective): happening often. "Frequent merges" happen often; the noun is frequency.

items.question: Trong câu "Merge queues / merge trains stop two green PRs from breaking main together.", từ "stop from" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Merge queues / merge trains stop two green PRs from breaking main together.", what does "stop from" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: stop from /stɒp frəm/ (cụm từ): ngăn không cho. "Stop X from doing Y" = ngăn X làm Y.
items.explanationEn: stop from /stɒp frəm/ (phrase): to prevent from doing. "Stop X from doing Y" means to prevent X doing Y.

items.question: Trong câu "Cache ≠ artifact: caches are disposable, keyed on lockfile hashes; artifacts are required outputs.", từ "disposable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Cache ≠ artifact: caches are disposable, keyed on lockfile hashes; artifacts are required outputs.", what does "disposable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: disposable /dɪˈspəʊ.zə.bəl/ (tính từ): có thể bỏ đi. "Disposable" = dùng xong bỏ được; "disposable income" = thu nhập khả dụng.
items.explanationEn: disposable /dɪˈspəʊ.zə.bəl/ (adjective): safe to throw away. "Disposable" means it can be thrown away; "disposable income" is money left to spend.

items.question: Trong câu "OIDC for cloud access; scoped GITHUB_TOKEN; beware pull_request_target; no self-hosted runners on public repos.", từ "beware" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "OIDC for cloud access; scoped GITHUB_TOKEN; beware pull_request_target; no self-hosted runners on public repos.", what does "beware" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: beware /bɪˈweə/ (động từ): cẩn thận với. "Beware (of) X" = hãy cảnh giác với X; thường dùng ở dạng mệnh lệnh.
items.explanationEn: beware /bɪˈweə/ (verb): to be careful of. "Beware (of) X" means be on guard against X; usually used as a command.

items.question: Trong câu "The output is one immutable, versioned, scanned, signed artifact with an SBOM — ready for delivery in topic 14.", từ "immutable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The output is one immutable, versioned, scanned, signed artifact with an SBOM — ready for delivery in topic 14.", what does "immutable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: immutable /ɪˈmjuː.tə.bəl/ (tính từ): bất biến. "Immutable artifact" = artifact không bị thay đổi sau khi tạo.
items.explanationEn: immutable /ɪˈmjuː.tə.bəl/ (adjective): unable to be changed. An immutable artifact never changes after it is created.
